eq_why_us.prompt: So. Why do you want to work here?

answers.text: {insider}
answers.reaction: ...You actually read about us. That's rarer than you'd think.

answers.text: Honestly? Rent.
answers.reaction: Fair. Relatable. Not an answer, but fair.

answers.text: What do you do again?
answers.reaction: We have a website. It has an About page. It's right there.

eq_friday_deploy.prompt: Friday, 4:55 PM. Your change is untested. What do you do?

answers.text: Test it, get a review, ship Monday.
answers.reaction: Correct. Weekends are for sleeping, not rollbacks.

answers.text: Ask the team channel what to do.
answers.reaction: Safe. The channel replies 'LGTM' (looks good to me) to everything.

answers.text: Deploy and turn off my phone.
answers.reaction: Bold. You just described our last three incidents.

eq_credit_theft.prompt: Your teammate fixed the bug. In the meeting, your manager thanks YOU.

answers.text: Say it was Jordan's fix, not mine.
answers.reaction: Correct. Steal credit once and nobody reviews your code again.

answers.text: Say nothing, thank Jordan later.
answers.reaction: Half credit. Jordan noticed. Jordan remembers.

answers.text: 'Thanks, it was really hard.'
answers.reaction: Jordan is in this meeting. Jordan is looking at you.

exclusive.text: At my internship we shared credit.
exclusive.reaction: You mention the internship a lot. Correct answer, though.

eq_outage_blame.prompt: Your change took checkout down for 10 minutes. The postmortem is tomorrow.

answers.text: Own it: cause, fix, and prevention.
answers.reaction: Perfect. Postmortems fix systems, not people.

answers.text: Say it was 'a config issue'.
answers.reaction: True. And who changed the config? (You. It was you.)

answers.text: Blame the intern.
answers.reaction: We don't have an intern. We have you.

eq_ai_takehome.prompt: Did you use an AI assistant on your take-home?

answers.text: Yes. I reviewed and tested every line.
answers.reaction: Great. We allow tools. We don't allow mysteries.

answers.text: A little. Mostly for vibes.
answers.reaction: Vibes don't pass code review. Close, though.

answers.text: Never. What's an AI?
answers.reaction: Your screen share shows Guessomatic. Open. Right now.

eq_leaked_password.prompt: The production database password is posted in a public team channel.

answers.text: Tell security so it gets rotated.
answers.reaction: Exactly. A leaked secret is a burned secret.

answers.text: Delete the message and move on.
answers.reaction: Deleted is not rotated. The bots already saw it.

answers.text: Screenshot it. Might be handy.
answers.reaction: Please stay seated. Legal is walking over.

eq_celebrity_orders.prompt: A coworker dares you to look up a celebrity customer's order history.

answers.text: No. No business reason, no access.
answers.reaction: Correct. Also: every query is logged.

answers.text: Only if we anonymize it first.
answers.reaction: Nice try. It's still a person's data.

answers.text: Sure, in incognito mode.
answers.reaction: Incognito hides it from your browser. Not from our audit logs.

eq_meeting_overload.prompt: Six hours of meetings today. Your deadline is tomorrow.

answers.text: Skip the optional ones, ask for notes.
answers.reaction: Healthy boundaries! Rare here, but healthy.

answers.text: Attend all, camera off, code quietly.
answers.reaction: Relatable. Our nod-detection AI flagged you anyway.

answers.text: Book a meeting about fewer meetings.
answers.reaction: Accepted. It's recurring now. Weekly.

eq_impossible_deadline.prompt: Your product manager wants a 3-month feature by Friday.

answers.text: Offer a smaller v1 and flag the risks.
answers.reaction: Scope, risks, in writing. Someone's been burned before.

answers.text: Say yes and hope.
answers.reaction: Hope is not a sprint plan.

answers.text: Ship a 'Coming Soon' button.
answers.reaction: ...That is literally our roadmap.

exclusive.text: Per my PM course: cut scope, flag risk.

eq_harsh_review.prompt: A senior dev comments 'this is garbage' on your pull request.

answers.text: Ask what to fix; raise tone privately.
answers.reaction: Mature. And yes, raise it. 'Garbage' isn't feedback.

answers.text: Fix it silently and seethe.
answers.reaction: Fixed code, unfixed feelings. Half marks.

answers.text: Reply 'no u'.
answers.reaction: A classic. Not a career move.

exclusive.text: My only reviewer so far is Guessomatic.
exclusive.reaction: Honest. Open-source code reviews would change that. Try it.

answers.text: I over-polish, so now I timebox.
answers.reaction: A real answer! I'm writing that down in pen.

answers.text: I'm a perfectionist who works too hard.
answers.reaction: That's the 3,000th time I've heard that. Second today.

answers.text: Garlic. And sunlight.
answers.reaction: ...Okay. We do have a night shift.

eq_grind_culture.prompt: We work 80-hour weeks here. Grind culture. You in?

answers.text: Committed, but at a sustainable pace.
answers.reaction: Most people just say yes. You didn't. That's... reassuring, actually.

answers.text: Is the pay 80 hours' worth too?
answers.reaction: Great question. Next question.

answers.text: I'll sleep under my desk.
answers.reaction: Love the energy. Our insurance does not.

eq_rto.prompt: Five days in the office, starting Monday. Thoughts?

answers.text: I'd ask why, then plan around it.
answers.reaction: A mature answer. I'm almost suspicious.

answers.text: Is it negotiable?
answers.reaction: Everything is negotiable. Except this.

answers.text: Badge in, grab coffee, leave.
answers.reaction: 'Coffee badging.' The badge readers have feelings now.

eq_any_questions.prompt: Do you have any questions for us?

answers.text: What does success look like in 90 days?
answers.reaction: Oh, a good question. Let me actually think.

answers.text: How soon can I take vacation?
answers.reaction: Day 91. After probation. Noted.

answers.text: No, I'm good.
answers.reaction: Not having questions is also an answer.
